recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration, in its capacity as secretariat to the United Nations Sustainable Development Group Business Innovations Group, establish and operationalize a standardized annual reporting mechanism to inform the Group and related task teams. The report should consolidate information on progress, implementation challenges and identified risks related to the efficiency road map and be based on inputs provided by participating entities and United Nations country teams.
